summary.text: Melody Cunningham is a Democratic state representative from Missoula who took office in January 2025 representing Montana House District 97 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A physician, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that healthcare, environmental care and public education are her main policy interests.

paragraphs.text: Melody Cunningham was born in Augusta, Maine, and earned a high school diploma from Acton Boxborough Regional High School, a bachelor's degree from Wellesley College in 1988 and an M.D. from the University of Massachusetts in 1994.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a first-generation college graduate raised by a single mother after her father died suddenly, and as a physician who paid for medical training at a state medical school with scholarships and loans.
Cunningham took office in the Montana House in January 2025, and in the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the House Judiciary Committee and the Human Services Committee.

In her 2026 survey responses she said that as "the only medical doctor of the 150 legislators in Montana" she would help fellow legislators understand the unintended consequences of bills, and that she would work to bring sufficient funding to public education.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Michael Hagestad in the general election.
